content: We just hit 5,000 days of running Crisp. That's 13+ years of watching law firms make the same operational mistake over and over. Here's what kills most practices: they treat their backend like it doesn't matter. Case management system is outdated. Billing is manual. Client communication happens in email chains nobody can find. Result? A 50-person firm operating like a 10-person shop. The math: if one attorney wastes 5 hours/week on admin work that software could handle, that's $52,000/year in lost billable time. Just one person. Now multiply that across your team. Here's how to fix it: (1) Audit where your team actually spends time — not guesses, actual time. (2) Map the three biggest time-sucks to existing software solutions. (3) Pick one system to implement this quarter — not five. (4) Train it properly or it dies. (5) Measure the time saved monthly. Your backend isn't boring. It's your profit margin.
